domain.text: vmethod GitHub read filtering: preserving PR-list, commit, and compare data while enforcing repository and identity boundaries.

impressions.text: The worker addressed the reported data loss by filtering list entries individually, preserving git-only commit attribution as unverified, and allowing scoped compare reads; the PR reports full local verification and green checks.
The orchestrator’s live smoke checks caught a blocking regression: PR `head` and `base` repository metadata was stripped because repository objects were treated as authored content.

The worker revised the filter to retain structural branch and repository metadata, and separated counts for removed list entries from nested redactions; it reported targeted regressions and full local checks passing.
The worker stopped and escalated when its assigned role could not run the required live smoke checks; the orchestrator confirmed those checks were orchestrator-only and took responsibility for them.
The orchestrator reported the revised head passed live smoke for PR metadata, git commits, and compare, while a foreign-org compare remained refused; the PR was awaiting owner approval.
